step1_analysis.description: A current-sensed SRAM sense amplifier using a cross-coupled NMOS pair (XM3, XM4) to resolve the bitline differential and a second NMOS pair (XM1, XM2) to drive the output data lines.

paper_reference.title: A 2-V 300-MHz 1-Mb Current-Sensed Double-Density SRAM for Low-Power 0.3-m CMOS/SIMOX ASICs

t_sense.description: Sensing delay from the enable signal (PHI_SAE) rising to the output node resolving to a valid logic level.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the discharge rate of the bitline and output capacitances through the NMOS cross-coupled pairs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 1.8V NMOS has high drive strength, easily discharging a 100fF bitline capacitance in a few hundred picoseconds.

energy_per_op.description: Energy consumed per sensing operation, dominated by recharging the bitlines and output nodes.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Energy is dominated by replenishing the charge on the bitline and output node that were pulled to ground during the sensing phase. Matches the paper's reported 0.198 pJ closely.

v_swing_out.description: Voltage swing of the output data lines after sensing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Outputs are precharged to VDD and one is pulled to GND by the sense amplifier.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Full rail swing is expected for the output nodes in this topology.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure sensing delay, output voltage swing, and energy per operation of the SRAM sense amplifier. Simulates a full precharge-sense-precharge cycle.
step3_testbench.spice:
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* Include SKY130 models
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* VDD and signals
Vdd VDD GND 1.8
Vphi PHI_SAE GND PULSE(0 1.8 1.2n 50p 50p 1.3n 5n)
Vpre PRE_B GND PULSE(1.8 0 1n 50p 50p 2n 5n)

* Bitline precharge voltages (50mV differential)
V3 N3_pre GND 1.8
V4 N4_pre GND 1.75

* Precharge switches
S3 N3_pre N3 PRE_B GND sw_ideal
S4 N4_pre N4 PRE_B GND sw_ideal
S1 VDD N1 PRE_B GND sw_ideal
S2 VDD N2 PRE_B GND sw_ideal
.model sw_ideal sw vt=0.9 vh=0.1 ron=100 roff=1G

* Capacitances (Bitlines and Outputs)
C1 N1 GND 10f
C2 N2 GND 10f
C3 N3 GND 100f
C4 N4 GND 100f
C5 N5 GND 5f

* Initial conditions to prevent massive startup current
.ic v(N1)=1.8 v(N2)=1.8 v(N3)=1.8 v(N4)=1.75 v(N5)=0

* DUT
XM1 N1 N2 N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N1 N3 N3 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N3 N5 N5 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N4 N5 N5 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 PHI_SAE GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

.control
tran 10p 5n uic

* Measure sensing delay
meas tran t_sense trig v(PHI_SAE) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure output voltage swing
meas tran v_out_high max v(N2)
meas tran v_out_low min v(N1)
let v_swing = v_out_high - v_out_low
print v_swing

* Measure energy per operation (integrating current from precharge sources)
meas tran q_v3 integ i(V3)
meas tran q_v4 integ i(V4)
meas tran q_vdd integ i(Vdd)
* Energy = V * I * t = V * Q. Current flows out of positive terminal, so i(V) is negative.
let energy_op = -1.8 * (q_v3 + q_v4 + q_vdd)
print energy_op

quit
.endc
